name: 00 页面目录 / 页面地图 6

node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.name: 状态
node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.text: 状态：运行/停止、失效身份、操作确认/错误

node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.name: 操作
node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.text: 操作：容器卡片/表格、启停/重启、日志详情、sh/bash终端

node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.name: 边界
node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.text: 边界：以完整容器及daemon身份校验，不能删除容器

node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.name: 操作
node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.text: 操作：搜索、排序、镜像名称/标签/ID/大小/创建时间

node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.name: 画布
node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.text: 画布：07 Docker / Compose 项目

node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.name: 状态
node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.text: 状态：数据不完整、计划变化、更新中/失败、成员变化

node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.name: 操作
node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.text: 操作：项目卡片、容器子状态；启动/停止/重启、更新计划与任务

node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.name: 边界
node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.text: 边界：新建项目、编辑Compose文件、自动回滚未实现

node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.name: 画布
node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.text: 画布：07 Docker / Compose 更新确认

node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.name: 状态
node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.text: 状态：成员变化、来源不完整禁用、分阶段失败/取消

node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.name: 操作
node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.text: 操作：确认服务器及已发现服务、计划核对、下载、复核与重建；查看任务

node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.name: 边界
node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.text: 边界：不承诺自动回滚，不扩大到未选容器

node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.name: 范围
node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.text: 设计目录，不是 App 内的新页面。以正式源码和需求状态为准。

node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.name: 画布
node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.text: 画布：07 Docker / 容器日志与详情

node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.name: 状态
node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.text: 状态：加载、失败、截断、容器已停止

node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.name: 操作
node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.text: 操作：日志/详情切换、行数、搜索、复制、暂停/跟随；容器终端

node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.name: 边界
node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.text: 边界：日志有界；容器终端为真实PTY

node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.name: 入口
node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.text: 入口：容器菜单→日志/详情

node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.name: 画布
node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.text: 画布：09 工具 / 服务器备注

node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.name: 状态
node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.text: 状态：读取中、失败重试、保存中、冲突/未保存确认

node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.name: 操作
node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.text: 操作：查看和编辑服务器备注

node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.name: 边界
node_00_6_u21f38fb9_desktop_6_desktop_u2.text: 边界：备注与登录凭据分离；不推断服务器实时信息
